SlideDeckState.title: SlideDeckState
SlideDeckState.description: Active cross-device state of inline slide text edits and last exported Google Slides presentation metadata for a user.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this slide deck state.

edits.description: Map of data-editable slide key identifiers to customized HTML/text strings.

lastExportedSlidesId.description: Google Slides presentation ID from the most recent export.

lastExportedSlidesUrl.description: URL of the most recently exported Google Slides deck in Google Drive.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this slide state was created or last updated.

SlideRevision.title: SlideRevision
SlideRevision.description: Named or timestamped revision snapshot of customized slide text edits and optional Google Slides link.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this revision snapshot.

label.description: Human-readable label describing the revision snapshot.

edits.description: Map of data-editable slide key identifiers to customized HTML/text strings.

slidesUrl.description: Optional URL of an exported Google Slides presentation associated with this revision.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the revision was created.

AudienceSyncSession.title: AudienceSyncSession
AudienceSyncSession.description: Real-time presenter slide synchronization session linking audience browsers to the presenter's active slide and callout.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated presenter hosting the sync session.

sessionCode.description: Normalized room code matching the document/node ID (e.g., UFSC-2026).

presenterName.description: Display name of the presenter (Ana Vitória Vanzin Mendes · UFSC).

slideTitle.description: Heading of the currently active slide.

activeCallout.description: Optional active visual callout or detail identifier on the current slide.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the broadcast session.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest slide transition.

/users/{userId}/slideDecks/{deckId}.description: Stores the user's active cross-device slide edits and latest Google Slides export metadata.

/users/{userId}/revisions/{revisionId}.description: Stores timestamped revision history snapshots of the user's slide edits.

/syncSessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores live presenter slide synchronization state so audience browsers can follow the current slide.
